tools.name: brotherpos_list_products
tools.description: List active products with prices, stock levels, categories and brand. Filter by search text, category slug, exact brand name or updated_since. Brother POS API: GET /api/v1/products.

tools.name: brotherpos_get_product
tools.description: Get one product by id, with stock, prices and variations. Brother POS API: GET /api/v1/products/{id}.

tools.name: brotherpos_list_categories
tools.description: List product categories with their slugs. Not paginated. Brother POS API: GET /api/v1/categories.

tools.name: brotherpos_list_brands
tools.description: List product brands. Not paginated. Brother POS API: GET /api/v1/brands.

tools.name: brotherpos_list_customers
tools.description: List customers, most recently updated first, with loyalty tier and points, visit count and spend. Search by name, email, phone, customer code or loyalty card. Brother POS API: GET /api/v1/customers.

tools.name: brotherpos_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id. Brother POS API: GET /api/v1/customers/{id}.

tools.name: brotherpos_find_customer_by_code
tools.description: Find one customer by customer code (format C#####). Brother POS API: GET /api/v1/customers/lookup_by_code/{code}.

tools.name: brotherpos_find_customer_by_card
tools.description: Find one customer by loyalty card number. Brother POS API: GET /api/v1/customers/lookup_by_card/{card_number}.

tools.name: brotherpos_get_customer_recent_sales
tools.description: Get a customer's last 5 completed sales and the grams bought today. Brother POS API: GET /api/v1/customers/{id}/recent_sales.

tools.name: brotherpos_create_customer
tools.description: Create a customer. If a customer with the same phone or email exists, nothing is created and the existing record returns (duplicate: true) unless force_create is true. Brother POS API: POST /api/v1/customers.

tools.name: brotherpos_update_customer
tools.description: Update a customer's contact or loyalty-card fields. Only the fields you send change. Brother POS API: PATCH /api/v1/customers/{id}.

tools.name: brotherpos_list_sales
tools.description: List sales, newest first. Defaults to today. period, or start_date with end_date (store timezone), set the date window. A search or status=pending ignores the window. Brother POS API: GET /api/v1/sales.

tools.name: brotherpos_get_sale
tools.description: Get one sale with its line items and payment method. Brother POS API: GET /api/v1/sales/{id}.

tools.name: brotherpos_list_purchase_orders
tools.description: List purchase orders with their lines, newest first. Filter by status, supplier, updated_since or with_variance (short, over or unexpected lines). Brother POS API: GET /api/v1/purchase_orders.

tools.name: brotherpos_get_purchase_order
tools.description: Get one purchase order with its lines and received quantities. Brother POS API: GET /api/v1/purchase_orders/{id}.

tools.name: brotherpos_list_stock_adjustments
tools.description: List the stock adjustment ledger: receipts, counts, spoilage, damage and corrections, by creation time. Brother POS API: GET /api/v1/stock_adjustments.

tools.name: brotherpos_adjust_stock
tools.description: Record one stock movement for a product: receive or count with a quantity, or an inventory count (counted_quantity). Removals are negative (spoilage, damage and check_out must not be positive). Brother POS API: POST /api/v1/stock_adjustments.

tools.name: brotherpos_list_loyalty_tiers
tools.description: List active loyalty tiers with their spend and visit thresholds and benefits. Not paginated. Brother POS API: GET /api/v1/loyalty_tiers.

tools.name: brotherpos_list_loyalty_rewards
tools.description: List the loyalty rewards the store offers. Brother POS API: GET /api/v1/loyalty_rewards.

tools.name: brotherpos_get_customer_available_rewards
tools.description: List the loyalty rewards one customer can redeem now, with their points and tier. Brother POS API: GET /api/v1/loyalty_rewards/available?customer_id={id}.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "brotherpos_find_customer_by_code" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: brotherpos_list_customers, brotherpos_adjust_stock · Private data: brotherpos_create_customer, brotherpos_update_customer, brotherpos_adjust_stock · Public sink: brotherpos_list_customers, brotherpos_create_customer, brotherpos_update_customer, brotherpos_adjust_stock · Destructive: brotherpos_find_customer_by_code.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: brotherpos_list_customers, brotherpos_adjust_stock · Private data: brotherpos_create_customer, brotherpos_update_customer, brotherpos_adjust_stock · Public sink: brotherpos_list_customers, brotherpos_create_customer, brotherpos_update_customer, brotherpos_adjust_stock · Destructive: brotherpos_find_customer_by_code

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
